title: South Goa Temple Run
summary: Goa's sacred temples, far from the beaches.
overview: Follow a carefully paced route through Nageshi, Mangeshi and Shanta Durga, Saptakoteshwar, Bhairoba Goa.
discover: Begin with two of Goa's best-known temples and their distinctive architecture.
Spend the day on the history and story of this ancient Shiva temple.
Visit the local shrine, learn about village deity traditions, and wrap up the trip.

title: Marathwada Heritage Trail
summary: Deccan history, from sultanates to the Nizams.
overview: Follow a carefully paced route through Solapur, Latur, Hyderabad, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, then return to Pune.
highlights: Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, then return to Pune

Continue through the heart of Marathwada.
Spend the day on the monuments and old city of the Nizams.
Close with the caves, forts, and tombs of the old Deccan capital.
